finalResult.nextParagraphText: Jake didn’t even bother giving that a response as he frowned. “You’re really just gonna spin it like that? Blame everything on a now-dead entity?”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “That is how it will be framed,” Jacob said as he walked forward, gazing out at the nearby land still filled with desolation. “The False God appeared amidst negotiations between the Chosen of the Malefic Viper and the Holy Church, disrupting everything and killing everyone present in the city besides a scarce few.
